item.title: Portfolio Ideas for Non-Design Roles 🌟 • Identify 2–3 impactful projects you've led. • Create a one-page case study for each project. • Include metrics: Use "I increased efficiency by 20%..." • Add visuals like charts or process diagrams. • Compile everything into a shareable PDF. What story will your portfolio tell about your impact and skills? #portfolio #careeradvice #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
